domain_sizes: Uniform choice from the task's distinct original training domain sizes on each proposal
regular_sampler: P and Q: independently uniform subset with size uniform from max(1,floor(.15*n)) through min(n-1,floor(.85*n)). Each node has exactly 2 distinct outgoing edges for each of R and S; self edges allowed.

structural_regular_skip.hard_070: Gold is identically true under positive regular R out-degree, so no balanced regular proposal can pass.

fallback_sampler: Keep unary sampler; independently choose R and S edge probabilities uniformly from binary_probability_grid per proposal, then sample each directed edge independently. Self edges and zero out-degree nodes are allowed.
acceptance: Accept in proposal order only when gold labels are balanced, structure is not a duplicate of a training or already retained holdout world, and fewer than five worlds have been retained. Never use a model answer or counterexample search.
seed: First 16 SHA256 hex digits of seed_namespace + ':' + task_id + ':' + stage, interpreted as an integer; Python random.Random, separate regular/fallback streams
failure: Fail the entire build if any task remains short. Never emit a partial release.
distribution_note: Versioned completion of legacy rejection-sampled worlds with a declared variable-degree fallback; NOT an unchanged IID sample from the legacy regular-degree sampler.
